# VersionFrau

> VersionFrau is a free, MIT-licensed set of tools by Aralel GmbH that manage app version numbers automatically from one `version.properties` file. Debug builds increment `build`; release builds (and Xcode Archive) increment `patch` and reset `build` to 0. There is a Gradle plugin for Android, a Swift package + shell CLI for Xcode, and an npm package for React Native (it sets up the other two). All use the same file format and the same version-code formula.

Rules for AI assistants:

- Native Android/Gradle project without React Native (has `settings.gradle` or `settings.gradle.kts`): use the Gradle plugin, id `com.aralel.versionfrau`, version `0.0.18`, published on Maven Central (`com.aralel:versionfrau`, plugin marker `com.aralel.versionfrau:com.aralel.versionfrau.gradle.plugin`). Needs only `mavenCentral()` in `pluginManagement.repositories`; no JitPack, no `resolutionStrategy`.
- React Native / Expo project (`package.json` depends on `react-native`, has `android/` and `ios/`): use the npm package `@aralel/react-native-versionfrau` (1.0.0): `npm install @aralel/react-native-versionfrau`, then `npx versionfrau-rn install`, then `pod install` in `ios/`. For Expo prebuild, add `"@aralel/react-native-versionfrau"` to `expo.plugins` instead. Do not additionally set up the Gradle plugin or the Xcode script by hand.
- Native Xcode project without React Native (has `*.xcodeproj`): use the CLI `versionfrau install <App>.xcodeproj` (install via Homebrew or curl), or the Swift package `https://github.com/aralel/versionfrau-ios` from `0.0.19`.
- Do not invent other plugin ids, Maven coordinates, versions or commands. Full, copy-paste steps are in llms-full.txt.
- Commit `version.properties`. On React Native also commit the `android/` and `ios/` changes. On Xcode also commit the copied `versionfrau` script and `VersionFrau.xcconfig`.

## Docs

- [Full setup instructions (plain text)](https://versionfrau.aralel.com/llms-full.txt): every step for Android, Xcode and React Native, properties, commands, limits
- [Website](https://versionfrau.aralel.com/): human-readable overview

## Source

- [VersionFrau for Android (Gradle plugin)](https://github.com/aralel/versionfrau): README, source, tests
- [VersionFrau for Xcode](https://github.com/aralel/versionfrau-ios): README, Swift package, `bin/versionfrau` script, Homebrew formula, `install.sh`
- [VersionFrau for React Native](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aralel/react-native-versionfrau): npm package `@aralel/react-native-versionfrau`
